findings.suggested_fix: Split compound criteria, replace subjective terms with observable outcomes, and state how each is verified.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Define the approval-status vocabulary for decisions 1-6 by co-locating or citing the rebar-janitor Phase-4 enum (approve / refine / reject), and specify an explicit value (e.g. 'unrecoverable/uncertain', tied to the required confidence label) for a decision whose approval state the transcript does not resolve.
evidence: examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/approval.md L24-30 defines the closed verdict enum: 'The user responds approve / refine / reject'
The plan AC requires an 'approval status' for all six decisions but neither co-locates nor cites this vocabulary
This is a rebar-janitor transcript recovery, so Phase-4 verdicts are the vocabulary the report should map onto
No value is specified for the case where the transcript does not resolve a decision's approval state (an unspecified fallback for an incomplete sub-step)
findings.finding: The AC requires each of decisions 1-6 to state an 'approval status', but the plan never defines or cites the value vocabulary for that field; rebar-janitor Phase 4 defines a closed verdict enum (approve / refine / reject) that is the natural source vocabulary, and no fallback value is specified for a transcript state that cannot be recoverably resolved.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria: 'Each of decisions 1-6 states its approval status.' (and Plan bullet: 'Recover decisions 1-6 individually, tracing ... approval state')
scenarios: A transcript decision the user 'refined' rather than plainly approved is recorded as 'approved', collapsing the refine/reject distinction the skill treats as load-bearing
Six decisions receive six differently-worded approval labels (e.g. 'approved' vs 'yes' vs 'pending'), defeating the report's legibility and cross-check
A decision whose approval state is unrecoverable is given an ad-hoc label instead of a defined uncertainty value tied to the required confidence label
findings.suggested_fix: State that 'approval status' is drawn from the Phase-4 closed set {approve, refine, reject} (per examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/approval.md), plus an explicit 'unrecoverable' value used when the transcript does not resolve the verdict, and require that value to carry the mandated uncertainty label.
